## Still partial at 0c2aeb96
- row 1 `access-security.rls-both-sides` acceptance[5]: unchanged, D11 spot-check still needs the private write-up (#33532).
- row 2 `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` acceptance[5]: unchanged, no door binds a permission set to the guest anchor (#23267) (#33532).
- new: `studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix` (rev 9): the #33101 repro passes, but only 11 of 37 matrix rows were driven (rows 3–5, 8–11, 14–21, 23–25, 28–36 not reached); the matrix split its knownGaps[3] owes is still owed (#33534).

## Checklist-accuracy notes (not extracted)

From #33532:
- `platform-core.seed-integrity` steps[1] still states the old baseline (invoice_line 7, 138 rows); at 0c2aeb96 the artifact authors 10 lines / 141 rows — the run used the re-derived values.
- `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` acceptance[1] lists `os dev` among the development boots whose refusal shows `--dev`; in practice `os dev` catches the refusal and runs the ceremony itself after a backup (ADR-0131 D10 development exception, `dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.ts`); only `os serve --dev` shows the operator-facing `--dev` refusal.
- `cli-18-prerelease-db` recipe knownGaps[4] is stale: the restore now re-dates the shard (`sys_activity__r20261027 → __r20261113`), so the refused first boot and the apply keep all 66 rows; the second served boot then empties the shard by 14-day retention (rows' own timestamps), not by the apply.
- `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs`: the `fixture.json` it writes lacks the `organization` key its stdout JSON carries.
- `records-forms.crud-roundtrip`: the record's own menu must be targeted inside `main header` (sidebar "More actions for …" buttons share the name); after a delete the list keeps its quick-search filter across navigation and reload.

From #33534:
- `access-security.permission-set-address-in-execution-context` steps[3]: the package-less row does not survive the restart it needs — the cold-boot activation-ledger backfill (ADR-0150 D8 R4) binds it to the name's one holder, so acceptance[3] measures the rebound row (answers still match).
- `cli.validate-v18-authoring-verdicts` steps[2] should name `defineStack(x, { strict: false })`; inside a strict defineStack `os lint` never sees the omitted `required`.
- `studio-authoring.expression-editors` steps[1]: `record.quantity * record.unit_price` infers Unknown in both engine and editor, so it is not a proven-Number example.
- `automation.package-flow-override`: at 1500 px the override chip sits in the header itself, not folded into More.
- `records-forms.home-amount-preview-states` acceptance[2].verify quotes "2024-06-01"; the page shows the user's format "Jun 1, 2024".
- `records-forms.related-list-server-pagination` steps[1] says the wide layout has no tab strip; at 1440×900 the page draws one (clauses unaffected).
- `platform-core.docs-portal-render` steps[3]: a package with a single book skips its docs index and opens the book directly, by design.

## Fixture gaps (#33534)
- `records-forms.home-amount-preview-states` steps[2]: the fixture member's invoice has no currency and no lines, so no preview can mount; the runner added currency USD and one line as the member.
- `cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json`: an `os deploy` to a showcase booted in the shared tree writes into the shared `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/`; the target runtime should boot from a scratch copy.
